findings.title: Encryptor removes a pre-existing overwrite destination after failed decryption
findings.reproduction: Run probes/encryptor-openssl.py. Re-derive actual AppleScript OpenSSL templates; encrypt private synthetic input successfully; prepopulate destination sentinel; run wrong-password decrypt then exact source failure cleanup. OpenSSL exit1, original destination bytes replaced, destination removed. Correct-password control round-trips. AppleScript/packaged app itself not executed.
findings.root_cause: process_file directs OpenSSL -out at final destination and catch unconditionally rm -f that destination, without newly owned stage or previous-output restoration authority.
findings.silent_failure: Decryption failure alert is loud, but destruction of a formerly existing overwrite target is not disclosed; launcher tests do not cover conversion failure.
findings.regression_test: Actual conversion owner: pre-existing destination under wrong password/corruption/subprocess refusal remains byte-exact, successful control publishes complete stage only after ACK; cleanup owns only exact new stage.
findings.native_execution: Real OpenSSL/Linux shell on private disposable fixtures; no AppleScript/LaunchServices/Mac runtime

findings.title: Encryptor hidden password is embedded in shell command arguments
findings.confidentiality: Password leaves hidden-input/private-channel boundary through do shell script command text and -pass pass: argument; local process-inspection permissions bound observer access.
findings.reproduction: Run probes/encryptor-openssl.py. Exact source-built command contains synthetic password; sentinel observed in own Linux /bin/sh -c argv while real OpenSSL runs. Sentinel not observed in OpenSSL child argv in this run. No measured macOS process-table claim.
findings.root_cause: AppleScript concatenates quoted password after -pass pass: then executes whole command string; shell quoting is not argument confidentiality.
findings.silent_failure: Conversion succeeds and password UI is hidden, so user receives no indication credential traveled in process argument text.
findings.regression_test: Record actual native command argv and private input channel with sentinel: zero secret bytes in argv/logs, exact password delivery through bounded private pipe/fd; retain conversion failure controls.
findings.native_execution: Own Linux shell argv observed; Mac visibility unmeasured

findings.title: Raw envelope-prefixed typed text bypasses macOS SQL payload encryption
findings.confidentiality: Enabled text-column protection is bypassed by raw user content colliding with persistence marker; event JSON remains independently encrypted.
findings.reproduction: Run probes/cipher-prefix.lua. Actual mac TextCipher + actual sqlite_writer.build_inserts: ordinary text absent from SQL and two primitive calls; raw ergopti-enc-v1:SENTINEL-PRIVATE-CONTENT literal retained in SQL with only event-JSON primitive call. Authentic-envelope-lookalike raw text retained then interpreted by decrypt. No DB or live crypto store.
findings.root_cause: Raw e.text reaches Cipher.encrypt which treats prefix-only TextCrypto.is_encrypted as proof of presealed provenance and returns it unchanged. Migration uses same marker classification.
findings.silent_failure: SQL writer receives a successful string; real-envelope idempotence tests pass without raw-content collision vectors, so enabled setting can coexist with clear text-column data.
findings.regression_test: At actual raw ingress encrypt and round-trip ordinary text, malformed marker and authentic-envelope-shaped literal; preserve stored-envelope migration idempotence using provenance/metadata rather than prefix-only user-content classification.
findings.native_execution: Production Lua modules executed with recording native primitive ports; Windows/Linux share root and require dedup

findings.title: HuggingFace login credential is embedded in native bash argv
findings.confidentiality: Synthetic HF credential observed in actual TaskLifecycle.native argument vector before start; native process visibility itself not measured on Mac.
findings.reproduction: Run probes/hf-secret-argv.lua. Actual HF mixin/direct flow acquires /bin/bash task with {-c,login_script}; recording native port sees synthetic hf credential inside argv[2]. Start refused, effects0; no HTTP/file/Keychain access.
findings.root_cause: _process_hf_token embeds escaped token in Python source inside login_script, then passes complete script as bash -c argument rather than private stdin.
findings.silent_failure: Auth can work normally and lifecycle tests verify cancellation/ownership rather than absence of credential bytes in native arguments.
findings.regression_test: Actual prompt/direct flow with recording native task args/stdin: no credential in argv/logs; bounded exact private delivery. Keep native SDK token file and optional git helper compatibility separate.
findings.native_execution: Actual Lua mixin executed; native acquisition recorded and start refused

findings.title: Failed API secret replacement restores old metadata pointing to overwritten Keychain value
findings.reproduction: Run probes/api-replacement-rollback.lua. Existing local-omlx combined state references OLD in-memory keychain value. Same-id token edit invokes real coordinator+TokenCrypto; native helper port updates account to NEW. Inject final settings readback corruption: durable=false/settings_readback_failed, prior metadata/reference restored, but referenced account still NEW and OLD lost.
findings.root_cause: Stable entry id is also mutable Keychain account identity. SecItemUpdate overwrites secret before final metadata publication; rollback compensates settings/runtime references only and cannot restore original secret bytes.
findings.silent_failure: Metadata rollback/readback checks succeed while authentication silently changes after a reported refused edit. Referenced-account cleanup intentionally does not delete it and has no old secret revision to restore.
findings.regression_test: Existing persisted credential replacement with final publish/readback refusal, supersession, cancellation/timeout after native mutation: retained reference resolves prior secret or explicit truthful committed-new result. Prefer immutable secret revisions until metadata ACK, retire old afterward.
findings.native_execution: Real coordinator and TokenCrypto; in-memory signed-helper/settings ports; no live Keychain

findings.title: Refused migration slice timer leaves successful-start receipt and permanently running idle pass
findings.reproduction: Run probes/migration-scheduler.lua. Actual mac migration wrapper/shared runner/cipher/SQL modules with actual TimerScheduler over safe hs.timer/data ports: native start returns false and adapter returns handle,committed=false; start_for_posture returns true, runningtrue, rewritten_rows0. Healthy committed-timer control rewrites1 and ends.
findings.root_cause: Shared migration arm retains only first Scheduler.after return and ignores explicit committed ACK; start/resume return true regardless, and rearm has same hole.
findings.silent_failure: Native scheduler can log acquisition error, but migration owner never rejects/settles pass or progress and historical rows remain in old posture indefinitely.
findings.regression_test: Actual wrapper over native timer false/nil/throw/rollback-debt and later rearm refusal: no successful-running pass without admitted slice; truthful failure/retry while preserving exact timer cleanup and cursor-after-apply.
findings.native_execution: Actual production TimerScheduler + migration/cipher/SQL modules executed; native hs.timer/data ports recording-only, no actual native timer/DB
